description: Reviewed sources of Ryu's generated tool catalog tier (Treg parity C1), read by tools/tool-catalog-generate.ts. Only vendor-published OpenAPI specs: each source names the spec URL, who publishes it (publishedBy says why it is the vendor's own), the date it was checked and the SHA-256 of the exact bytes the generated rows come from; a spec whose bytes change is refused until a reviewed --refresh. Never another catalog (Treg's catalog and hosted catalog API are refused by the clean-room rule). judgements are reviewed decisions carried by operation ("METHOD /path"): exclude it with a reason, or set its endpoint id, title, or platform and capability (capability-taxonomy-v1.json). A judgement whose operation leaves the spec fails the generator. Operations a curated row already covers (tool-catalog-v1.json operation or endpoint id) are left out: curated wins.

sources.publishedBy: Exa, in its own GitHub organization (github.com/exa-labs/openapi-spec)

judgements.reason: The spec's operationId is a server controller name; named to match its sibling research task operations.

sources.publishedBy: Tavily, on its own documentation site, under its API reference (docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference)

judgements.reason: Tavily's reference describes it as retrieving the raw content of the given URLs: the web.extract job.
Tavily's reference describes a crawl from a base URL that follows links and returns the pages: the web.crawl job.
